title: bolbitis subcrenata var. prolifera
intro: Bolbitis subcrenata var. prolifera, commonly known as the creeping fern, is a type of medicinal fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. The creeping fern is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, as well as its role in lowering cholesterol levels and blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Bolbitis subcrenata var. prolifera include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the creeping fern include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
